blocks.text: Scalars woh physical quantities hain jo sirf magnitude (size ya amount) se describe ho jati hain; un mein direction (simt) ka koi zikr nahi hota. Is liye scalars ki koi direction nahi hoti, aur unhen ek number aur us ke unit se poori tarah bataya ja sakta hai.

items: Mass: kisi cheez mein matter (maadde) ki amount. Example: 2 kg.
Distance: kisi cheez ke tay kiye hue raste ki total length, direction ko dekhe baghair. Example: 50 m.
Speed: kisi cheez ke distance tay karne ka rate (kitni jaldi). Example: 40 km h⁻¹.
Time: events (waqiaat) ka lagataar chalta hua sequence (silsila). Example: 20 seconds.
Energy: work karne ki capacity (salahiyat). Example: 25 J.
Temperature: kisi substance (maadde) ke particles (zarron) ki average kinetic energy ka measure (paimana). Example: 20°C.

blocks.prompt: Safar ke baad car ka odometer 50 km zyada dikhata hai aur speedometer zyada tar raste 40 km h⁻¹ dikhata raha. In mein se kaun si quantities scalar hain, aur kyun?
blocks.explanation: Dono scalar hain. Odometer distance (raste ki total length) batata hai aur speedometer speed (distance tay karne ka rate). Dono mein se koi bhi nahi batata ke car kis taraf gayi, is liye dono mein direction nahi.

items: Scalar: sirf magnitude, yani unit ke saath ek number; examples: mass, distance, speed, time, energy, temperature.
